This is a not-for-profit project aimed at bringing awareness on AEDs (Automatic External Defibrillators) for people living in the Maltese islands.

To register your AED to be included in our app, simply send us an email on aedmalta@gmail.com.

AED Malta features:
• Easily locate AEDs in Map View 
• Displays the nearest AED to your current location (w/ location services on)
• Click on AED to be accurately navigated in the shortest route possible 
• Pinch locator screen to view AEDs in your area
• View instructional videos explaining how to operate the AED
